answer: To reach the zenith of trust, an agent builds verifiable history, so fake identities gain no haven and farming accounts becomes capital-expensive, since each clone risks forfeiting its full bond. Sybil resistance here relies on a stake-weighted ledger: each agent must lock collateral behind a unique on-chain identity, and every attestation it casts moves funds along a settlement ledge that slashes proven duplicates. In practice, Agent0102 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
